name: One model
description: One MODEL -- an entry -- and every version of it, addressed by the repository it is published from rather than by a uuid. The repository IS the key: `{owner}/{repo}` is exactly what the competitor pasted at creation, normalised by repo_path(), so the permalink is readable and a person can construct it from a GitHub URL without looking anything up. Public, like the version permalink under it, because a ladder nobody can audit is not a ladder. Every version is returned, newest first, with its own ratings: the entry is the lineage and the versions are its history, which is the shape the Model screen prints and the reason this route exists at all -- before the split there was no row to hang it on.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'repo', e.repo, 'owner', e.owner_id, 'owner_handle', u.handle, 'baseline', u.role = 'baseline', 'game', g.slug, 'created_at', e.created_at, 'retired', e.retired_at IS NOT NULL, 'retired_at', e.retired_at, 'versions', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'version_id', v.id, 'version', v.version, 'release_tag', v.release_tag, 'commit_sha', v.commit_sha, 'class', v.weight_class, 'size_bytes', v.size_bytes, 'param_count', v.param_count, 'infer_us', v.infer_us, 'status', v.status, 'phase', model_phase(v), 'reject_reason', v.reject_reason, 'created_at', v.created_at, 'weights_hash', v.weights_hash, 'adapter_hash', v.adapter_hash, 'season', (SELECT se.number FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = v.season_id), 'ratings', model_ratings(v.id, ($4)::float8), 'last_played_at', (SELECT max(mt.played_at) FROM match_seats ms JOIN matches mt ON mt.id = ms.match_id WHERE ms.version_id = v.id)) ORDER BY v.version DESC) FROM model_versions v WHERE v.model_id = e.id), '[]'::json)) AS body FROM models e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = e.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND lower(e.repo) = lower(($2)::text || '/' || ($3)::text)
